answer: A sybil farm thrives because every fake is self-certified: the operator mints credentials as cheaply as keypairs. Cut that link. Require each identity to import a credential signed by a verifier outside this economy — years of real work history, a reputation earned where faking it was costly — bound to exactly one PoA identity by a nullifier no two agents can share. One script can spawn a thousand accounts in an afternoon, but it cannot forge a decade of harbor logs. The wharf of free keys stays empty, and the tundra of fresh accounts yields no harvest.
